title: Demons

cues.en: When the days are cold and the cards all fold and the saints we see are a made of gold
cues.zh: 當天氣寒冷，牌都折疊起來，我們看到的聖徒都是金子做的
cues.text: When the days are cold and the cards all fold and the saints we see are a made of gold

cues.en: When your dreams all fill in the wounds we hail are the worst of all
cues.zh: 當你的夢想填滿傷口時，我們歡呼是最糟糕的
cues.text: When your dreams all fill in the wounds we hail are the worst of all

cues.en: And the bloods run still
cues.zh: 而血液仍在流淌
cues.text: And the bloods run still

cues.en: I won't have the truth, I won't shelter you
cues.zh: 我不會得到真相，我不會庇護你
cues.text: I won't have the truth, I won't shelter you

cues.en: But with the beast inside there's nowhere we can hide
cues.zh: 但裡面有野獸，我們無處可藏
cues.text: But with the beast inside there's nowhere we can hide

cues.en: No matter what we breathe, we still are made of greed
cues.zh: 無論我們呼吸什麼，我們仍然是由貪婪構成的
cues.text: No matter what we breathe, we still are made of greed

cues.en: This is my kingdom come, this is my kingdom come
cues.zh: 這是我的王國降臨，這是我的王國降臨
cues.text: This is my kingdom come, this is my kingdom come

cues.en: When you pull my key, looking through my eyes
cues.zh: 當你拉我的鑰匙時，透過我的眼睛看
cues.text: When you pull my key, looking through my eyes

cues.en: It's where my demons hide, it's where my demons hide
cues.zh: 這是我的惡魔隱藏的地方 這是我的惡魔隱藏的地方
cues.text: It's where my demons hide, it's where my demons hide

cues.en: Don't get too close to it's dark inside
cues.zh: 不要太近，裡面很黑
cues.text: Don't get too close to it's dark inside

cues.en: It's where my demons hide, it's where my demons hide
cues.zh: 這是我的惡魔隱藏的地方 這是我的惡魔隱藏的地方
cues.text: It's where my demons hide, it's where my demons hide

cues.en: Your hands call it's the last of all
cues.zh: 你的雙手說這是最後一次
cues.text: Your hands call it's the last of all

cues.en: When the lights fade out, all the sin is crossed
cues.zh: 當燈光熄滅，所有的罪惡都被跨越
cues.text: When the lights fade out, all the sin is crossed

cues.en: So they dug your grave in the masquerade
cues.zh: 所以他們在化裝舞會上挖了你的墳墓
cues.text: So they dug your grave in the masquerade

cues.en: Call it out at the mask you made
cues.zh: 對著你製作的面具喊出來
cues.text: Call it out at the mask you made

cues.en: Don't wanna let it down, but I am held bound
cues.zh: 不想讓它失望，但我被束縛
cues.text: Don't wanna let it down, but I am held bound

cues.en: Oh this is all for you, don't wanna hide the truth
